title: DR reflection plan: security layer (54 relationship changes)
rationale: Relationship schemas in the security layer that the maintainer-note triage and the sorting-question reflection (cli/scripts/spec-enrich) want removed, renamed, reversed or retargeted. Each operation carries the claims and Clef's sorting answers as evidence and the plan's probability. Accepting an operation means DR applies it with apply-walk.ts; rejecting means the schema stays.

operations.rationale: Remove security.retentionpolicy.requires.security.countermeasure: security.retentionpolicy.mandates.security.countermeasure already exists and expresses it. Plan kind remove-duplicate, p 0.59; claims rel:security.retentionpolicy#1.

evidence.quote: The relationships security.retentionpolicy mandates security.countermeasure and security.retentionpolicy requires security.countermeasure overlap heavily, since both say the policy needs a control. Proposed: Keep mandates for the normative obligation and drop requires, or redefine requires strictly as an operational dependency.

Sorting answers (rel:security.retentionpolicy#1): best source of 'requires security.countermeasure': security.retentionpolicy (0.38), security.accountabilityrequirement (0.14), security.securitypolicy (0.11); best destination of 'security.retentionpolicy requires': security.countermeasure (0.60), none (0.27), security.auditconfig (0.05); best predicate: mandates (0.59), none (0.11), depends-on (0.10). Outcome: alternative (predicate=mandates).
